gaps.lead: The plane takes one hour; the train takes two.
gaps.explanation: half the time = twice as fast as.

gaps.lead: She'll be on a flight, so she can't join the call.
gaps.sentence: She'll be on a flight, so ___ join the call.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.

gaps.lead: The exam regulations forbid the use of mobile phones.
He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: The tickets cost so much that we stayed at home.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ we stayed at home.
gaps.explanation: so much (money) → such expensive tickets (no article with plurals).

gaps.lead: We couldn't see the lighthouse anywhere.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'nowhere' forces inversion: Nowhere could we see…
